scope.method: Every assigned title was read individually. Potential kinetic reports, uncertain formulations/populations, relevant model ancestry and potentially informative clinical/controller studies received abstract inspection. Decisions were assigned explicitly by record index, not by automated keyword/regex exclusion. Only supplied bibliography/abstracts were used for this screening pass; full-text inclusion is not claimed. Source-truncated abstracts and missing essential eligibility information remain explicit.
